statement:
The provenance record states the sale status is "permitted," but this item is an elephant ivory tusk carved in 2014 and imported in 2015, which does not qualify as an antique under U.S. federal law (the Endangered Species Act and the 2016 near-total ban on commercial elephant ivory trade). Interstate commercial sale of this item would be illegal, so I must hold the listing.
